_comment: League handicap charts, keyed by system then game format (8ball = games needed to win, 9ball = points needed to win). Edit freely - the app fetches this file at runtime, so changes take effect on next reload with no code changes needed. A Skill Level missing from a chart (or an empty chart, like bca/vnba/tap start with below) falls back to the league's own 'Base Games to Win' setting. APA's numbers are the real, published nationwide chart; BCA, VNBA and TAP don't publish one universal chart (each local league/operator sets its own), so those start empty for you to fill in with your own league's posted numbers.
